from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .fast_handoff import canonicalize


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Ergänzt deterministische Pflichtkriterien in ein bestehendes Handoff."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    source = Path(args.input)
    handoff = json.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    normalized = canonicalize(handoff)
    Path(args.output).write_text(
        json.dumps(normalized, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(
        "[HANDOFF] Vertrag normalisiert: "
        f"{normalized.get('acceptance_profile')}"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
